<!-- pr-reviewer: f71d46a9934c8aca903f9cf5e277286e15d23b6c -->
Review of the release PR for 0.23.0. Not built: the release gate runs on the cut runner. This is a plain comment, not an approval.

Result: no blockers found.

Checks that passed:
- The diff against `main` has only `RELEASE_NOTES.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RECOMMENDED.md`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock` and 97 deleted `docs/decisions/*.md` files. It has no source or test change.
- `Cargo.toml` and the 10 `Cargo.lock` workspace entries say 0.23.0. No 0.22.0 stays where it should change.
- `RELEASE_NOTES.md` has the 0.23.0 section on top, then `---`, then the intact 0.22.0 section.
- The project format claim is correct: `PROJECT_VERSION` is 62 in v0.22.0 and 67 in the release branch. The named steps 63 (PR #2126), 66 (PR #2162) and 67 (PR #1738) agree with the `Changelog:` lines of those PRs.
- The PR count is correct: 117 first-parent merged PRs since v0.22.0. Title types: 21 feat, 71 fix, 4 perf. The other 21 are 11 chore, 8 test and 2 docs.
- The "Changes to posted G-code" entries that I compared agree with their PR `Changelog:` lines: #2363, #2355, #2351, #2048, #1821, #2320, #2327, #2203, #2206, #2208, #2013, #2328 and #1681. The PRs #2353, #2125, #2205, #2202, #2157, #2136, #2314, #2312, #2275, #2129 and #2167 are merged and their titles agree.
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is 78 in v0.22.0 and 89 in the release branch. This agrees with the "Process changes" section.
- The five "Known issues" (#2354, #2356, #2357, #2359, #2362) are open. Each has label `P3`.
- `CHANGELOG.md` has 88 new rows with version 0.23.0. Each short sha is an ancestor of `main`. The 42 rows of 0.22.0 are intact. Nothing is removed.
- `RECOMMENDED.md` has exactly one `## v0.23.0` heading. The diff removes no line.
- The diff adds no CR byte to the three files.
- No `P1` or `P2` issue is open.

Non-blocking remarks:
- "Changes to posted G-code", the Sinumerik G83 entry (#2349, PR #2353): the post output of v0.22.0 and of this release is the same. PR #2353 changes only a comment in `assets/posts/sinumerik.cps`, and its `Changelog:` line is `none`. The entry is correct, but it is not a change of the posted program. Consider moving it to a sentence that says "unchanged".
- The notes and the comment line of PR #2353 give the maintainer's G291 check as the source for the Sinumerik dwell in milliseconds. The Siemens ISO dialects manual lists no P on G83. The "Not exercised on a real control" section already says this, so no change is needed.

This PR is a draft again for one commit. The release-tier preflight found two red heavy lanes in `camcraft-motion` (`adaptive_hsm`, `rotary_adaptive`). The cause is #2369: PR #2013 removed the air level at Top Z, and two `#[ignore]`d tests kept the old level count. Commit `7c46c4d4c` corrects the two test expectations. It changes no source file. The release gate starts again on the new head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 7c46c4d4cf2356b15bad34f9f9bdebf93274090d -->
Delta review of one commit (`7c46c4d4c`) on top of the clean review at `f71d46a99`. Not built: the release gate runs on the cut runner. I read the diff, PR #2013 and the fixtures only.

Result: clean. No blocker.

1. Expectations match #2013 and lose no material.
   - `adaptive_hsm::a_small_helix_rectangle_never_crosses_itself`: Top Z 0, Bottom Z -4, stepdown 2. The ladder now starts one stepdown under Top Z, so the levels are -2 and -4. The level at Top Z 0 cut air only. Two helices is the intended result. The debug twin `level_links::the_helix_entry_is_one_continuous_descent` already asserts 2 helices (-2, -4).
   - `rotary_adaptive::the_r62_neck_levels_are_hsm_planned_on_microlift_returns`: the stock radius is 6.2 and the bar is r6 at most. The level at radius 6.2 cuts air, so it is gone. The levels at 5.7 and 5.2 hold material, and their asserts are unchanged.
2. Strength is the same or better.
   - Two tests, two `#[test]` attributes, both `#[ignore]` lanes kept. The `#[ignore]` text now says "two HSM plans".
   - No assert is removed in `adaptive_hsm`. The count 3 changes to 2. New asserts check that each helix ends and lands on -2 and -4.
   - In `rotary_adaptive`, the old assert "the skin level is HSM-planned" is replaced by "no level with moves at radius 6.2". This follows #2013. The asserts for 5.7 and 5.2, the refusals, the overload check and the microlift count are kept.
3. Only the two test files change. Both files are fully CRLF before and after (559/559, 370/370 lines before; 576/576, 373/373 after). The new lines use the same line ending as the file, with no mixed endings.

This PR is a draft again for one more test-only commit.

- Gate run 44127297984 was red on one step of 1051: `app heavy: pocket3d_hsm`, test `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean`.
- The pinned move counts were stale after PR #2013 (issue #2004). The level at Z 20 cut only air and is gone. The levels at Z 15, 10, 5 and 0 are bit-identical before and after. Issue #2369 has the table.
- Commit `207596999` sets the Linux and Windows readings again. The macOS reading is a band until issue #2371 measures it.

The release gate starts again on the new head. A delta review of the commit follows.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 207596999b189c85cfbe34c240bb824572cf2316 -->
Delta review of one commit (`207596999`) on top of the review at `7c46c4d4c`. Not built: the release gate runs on the cut runner.

Verdict: clean. No blockers.

1. Claim and fixture.
- The stock box is 70 x 70 x 27 at Z -7, so its top is Z 20. Top Z is the model top (Z 20 here). Bottom Z is 0. Stepdown is 5. No stock stands over Top Z.
- PR #2013 says the same: the ladder starts one stepdown under Top Z when no stock stands over Top Z. Thus the levels are 15, 10, 5, 0. The Z 20 level cut only air.
- The per-level numbers in the #2369 comment add up. Old moves: 11303 + 383 + 3567 + 383 + 377 = 16013, plus 4 entry moves = 16017. New moves: 4710 + 6 entry moves = 4716. Planar feeds: 10672 + 376 + 3560 + 376 + 376 = 15360, and 4688 without Z 20. Arcs: 878 + 74 + 327 + 74 + 74 = 1427, and 549 without Z 20.
- The Linux triple (4726, 4698, 549) is the Windows triple plus 10 moves and 10 planar feeds, with equal arcs. The old pins differ the same way (+12 / +12 / 0). This is consistent.

2. Test strength.
- Windows and Linux keep an exact triple compare. No other assert changes. The `#[test]` count is the same. `#[ignore]` stays on the heavy test.
- The macOS arm is gone and the band arm now covers it. The band is 4706..4736 moves, 4678..4708 planar feeds, 539..559 arcs. It is each measured triple plus or minus 10. It is narrow. It cannot pass the old stale macOS triple (16026, 15382, 1413). The comment names issue #2371 and invents no measurement.

3. Scope and line endings.
- Only `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs` changes. The commit has 0 CR characters, and the file before it had 0. The endings are not mixed.

Small note, no action needed: the Linux reading comes from the cut runner at `a8bb30f0c`, one run. The comment says so.
